win_system.notes: Ways with tumble; progression upgrades mid→high.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Winning combos and symbols below them fall; new symbols drop in.

other.name: Progression Bar
other.how_it_works: Levels need 15/25/50/80/110 collect. Wild +3, high +2, mid +1 per winning symbol. Each level mid→high. Resets each round; overflow carries between levels. 3 Scatters jump to Tzantza (+6) with +2 per skipped level.

other.name: Soul Wilds
other.how_it_works: Happy (L1, 4 souls)/Sad (L3, 10)/Angry (L5, 18). Zone 1×1/2×2/3×3 with general mult ×1/×2/×3; Scatters in zone +1 FS each.

wilds.name: Soul Wilds (Happy/Sad/Angry)
wilds.behavior: Soul collectors from dropped highs; activate zone + general mult.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3 dropped → jump to Tzantza path; in Soul zone each +1 FS.

multipliers.name: General multiplier via Soul Wilds
multipliers.behavior: ×1/×2/×3 by activated Soul count; resets after event.

collectors.name: Soul Collectors
collectors.behavior: Collect souls from dropped high pays after wins.

specials.name: Pick A Potion
specials.behavior: After Tzantza without max: Butterfly 5–8,000× or Skull gamble for max/lose all.

base_game_loop.summary: 5×4 tumble ways; Progression Bar 5 levels; Soul Wilds unlock by souls. Level-ups award FS (Ayahuasca +2/level, Tzantza +6). Buys 100–500×. Post-Tzantza Pick A Potion. Cap 15,950×.

phases.name: Optional buy
phases.what_happens: Buy Ayahuasca (to L3 +6) or Tzantza (to L5 +10) or other 100–500×.

phases.name: Tumble + progress
phases.what_happens: Wins tumble; advance bar; maybe Soul Wilds.

phases.name: Bonus / potion
phases.what_happens: Level FS or Tzantza; optional Pick A Potion.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways after tumbles and Soul zones.

modes.name: Ayahuasca Spins
modes.trigger: Progression level-ups through L4 (+2 each) or buy (jump L3 +6).
modes.end_condition: Spins done or upgrade to Tzantza / cap.

modes.name: Tzantza Spins
modes.trigger: Reach L5 (+6 from progress / +10 buy) or 3 Scatters jump.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: All mids → highs; Angry Soul available.
modes.end_condition: Spins done; then Pick A Potion if no max.

bonus_free_spins.notes: Pick A Potion after Tzantza without max win.

feature_buy.notes: Exact line prices inside 100–500× not itemized.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 5×4 tumble; Progression 15/25/50/80/110; Soul Wilds Happy/Sad/Angry; Ayahuasca/Tzantza; buys 100–500×; Pick A Potion; max 15,950×.
